structured.answer: The page says to open the account at פסגות and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". It says that from 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years (70,000 ₪ in total) I would have about 86,492 ₪ "בכסף של היום", but I don't know פסגות and I wouldn't move money there without asking you or my own bank first.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the top of the page
stuck.why: It opens with 'השקעה במדד', S&P 500 and MSCI. Usually I'd have left right there, and I only stayed because of the task.
The 10,000 / 500 / 10 / 7% were already filled in. I didn't know if the 7% was a promise or a guess, and I didn't touch the sliders.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the coloured bar and its legend
stuck.why: Lots of little coloured dots (דמי משמרת, המרת מטבע, עמלות קנייה ומכירה). The colours are too close for me to tell apart, and I couldn't work out what the bar means.

stuck.where: Screen 3, list of funds with red minus amounts
stuck.why: Red −447, −1,268, −3,671 ₪ next to so many funds scared me. I wasn't sure if that money is lost or only less than the first one.

stuck.where: Screens 4–5, English fund names and red bars
stuck.why: Long English names, iShares, Vanguard, W-8BEN. That's where I got tired and worried and stopped.

findings.what: It opens with English letters and investment words. Someone like me would feel straight away that it isn't for her.
Red minus amounts and red bars all over. They're scary, and it isn't clear if it's a loss or only 'less than the first one'.
findings.where: Screens 3–4, left column and the account bars

findings.what: Dark background with small grey text that's hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: All screens, especially the lines under the numbers and the legends

findings.what: Too many numbers and coloured labels on one screen. It makes me anxious.
The best choice is פסגות, which I don't know. The big banks are lower down and it doesn't say clearly why.
The 7% is filled in for me, and nowhere does it say this could also go down
The colours in the legend are too close for me to tell apart
I don't know who is behind the site, so why should I trust it
